description: The document leaves `backend_id` of UpdateRoute optional, but the API requires it on every update. Observed 2026-10-14 in the live Project with a Load Balancer, two backends, a frontend and a route created for the purpose: `PUT /lb/v1/zones/fr-par-1/routes/{route_id}` with only `{"match":{"host_header":"b.example.com"}}` answered 400 `invalid_arguments` (`backend_id` / reason `constraint` / help_message `backend_id must be required got nil`); the same call with `backend_id` answered 200.
